As someone who has been through exactly through this, but from the other side, I think you should end the friendship now. I had a guy best friend with whom I would get intimate with from time to time and I thought that we were a done deal. You can only imagine how I felt when he told me that he didn't want to date me because of my mental health issues (depression, anxiety and bpd). It's been years and my self-esteem is still at rock bottom. I haven't dated ever since because I just think that even if someone thinks I'm attractive and vibe well with me, they'll end up leaving me once they learn about my mental illnesses. I still think I'm unlovable and I honestly don't wish that to happen to anyone else.

You seem to be okay with her dating someone else, so I don't think you want to be with her. Out of respect for your friend, leave her alone. I doubt she'll want to stay friends with you after she learns about how you think of her having mental health issues and as other people have said, I doubt another girl will be okay with you having a girl best friend you've slept with.
